title: fabrik_deck.py install's /tmp boot-wipe parser (D-1407) leaves two measured residues by design: (1) a comment naming a tmpfiles.d .conf path after a blank line inside a drop-in is read as a file header, so a refusal can name the wrong file (message only, the verdict is right); (2) the whole-contents rule reads no narrower glob as a wipe, so a drop-in such as R /tmp/[!.]* or R /tmp/claude-* that would delete the agent scratch at boot is not refused — the stock x11/snapd/systemd lines under /tmp force that line. Residue of the W-0c208792 review (round-5 seats); destination scripts/sysadmin/fabrik_deck.py::_tmp_lines (header rule) and ::_tmp_wipe_lines (glob rule), each change proven with systemd-tmpfiles --remove --boot --root= over a staged tree as the review did
